analysis.title: GS U.S. Industrials & Materials | let the games begin
key_insights: Desk scorecard for 10/27 industrials and materials earnings. Better: HRI, INIO, JBLU, JCI, LECO, UPS. Worse: ABG, AWI, CLW, GBX, SHW, XYL, WHR, WSO. Mixed: AIT, BA, HUBB, PNR.

HRI Q3 EPS $3.91 vs $2.99 consensus, EBITDA $603mm vs $583mm, and full year EBITDA guide raised to $2.10-2.15bn from $2.05-2.13bn. Desk says it supports equipment rental as the best place to be in machinery.

INIO Q3 sales $1.2bn vs $1.05bn consensus and EBITDA $245mm vs $198mm. Equipment order intake was $2.2bn, up 10% y/y, with data center and compression demand. Backlog is $8bn, up 142% y/y, and FY26 revenue and EBITDA outlooks were raised. Desk notes the 1.8x book to bill is solid but slower than the LTM 3.3x, and the debate is how the market trades the data center story.

JCI fiscal Q4 EPS $1.66 vs $1.59 consensus with organic sales up 12%. Q4 orders accelerated 44% organically and backlog is $23bn, up 43% y/y. FY27 EPS guide of $6.15-6.30 vs $6.15 consensus. Desk calls the guide conservative but the name crowded.

UPS Q3 EPS $1.69 vs $1.63 on sales of $22.9bn vs $22.3bn, including a $33mm gain on MD-11 asset sales. Full year revenue raised to $92.6bn and EPS guide implies $7.28 vs $7.19 consensus. Desk says it looks clean ex the gain, with estimates inching higher on an underperforming stock.

Housing and building-linked names missed. AWI Q3 EPS $2.26 vs $2.39 with guidance narrowed to the low end of EPS. SHW Q3 EPS $3.63 vs $3.69 with the full year midpoint unchanged. WSO Q3 EPS $3.77 vs $4.10. Desk expects the crowded building products miss to get sold and sees resi HVAC still weak.

XYL lowered FY guidance: EPS to $5.40-5.45 from $5.55-5.70 and organic revenue growth to 0% vs consensus +2.32%. Desk says defensives and water names now face a higher bar and XYL is more crowded than peers.
WHR Q3 loss of $0.21 vs $0.76 positive EPS expected, sales $3.68bn vs $3.91bn, and FY revenue outlook cut to $14.5bn from $15bn. FY ongoing loss per share guided to $1.30 vs prior EPS of $2.50-3.00.
GBX Q4 EPS $0.39 vs $0.80 consensus. 2027 EBIT margin guide of 7-7.5% is well below the 10% consensus.

BA Q3 free cash flow $464mm vs $325mm consensus, revenue $24.2bn in line, and headline EPS loss wider than expected. 777X still targets first delivery in 2027 and 737 production is heading to a stable 47 a month. Desk says 777X certification timing and 2027 free cash flow matter most and are unlikely to be updated before the call.

HUBB Q3 adj EPS $5.91 vs $5.76 consensus with the FY midpoint unchanged. Desk frames a debate between the multiple and estimate revisions: bulls say the stock has dislocated from higher estimates, bears point to other electricals with better growth.

AIT fiscal Q1 EPS $2.97 vs $2.89 on in-line sales. ES orders rose 30% and October organic sales are up 10% month to date vs 8% growth in consensus for the quarter. FY EPS guide raised to $11.70-12.20.

LECO Q3 EPS $2.98 vs $2.81 and sales $1.22bn vs $1.17bn. Desk says it looks better after management talked down incremental margins during conference season, and sees a SMID with AI upside and limited AI risk that could catch a bid.

PNR Q3 EPS $1.18 vs $1.07 includes $8mm of IEEPA refunds. Q4 EPS guide of $1.15 is below the $1.21 consensus. Desk says the stock is down 50% year to date so the bar is low, but beat-and-reiterate implies a softer Q4 and the IEEPA benefit was never well received.

ABG Q3 EPS $6.16 vs $6.42 consensus with sales store revenue down 6.5% and new vehicle weakness of 8%. Desk reads it as continued topline weakness and inflation pinching margins across autos, auto parts and auto retail.

Travel read-through from GS Evolving Traveler Series: airline fares are up double digits vs single-digit hotel rate increases, corporate travel rate and volume are tracking above last year, and Big 3 US airline share has rebalanced after American's distribution-change losses.
JBLU Q3 loss of $0.60 vs $0.55 consensus on in-line $2.8bn revenue. Q4 guide: RASM +18-22%, ASM +3-4%, flat CASMx, capex $300mm. Options imply a 15% move.
Desk flags GLW, HLT and RCL prints as worth watching for read-throughs and offers to connect clients with tech and consumer coverage.

HRI Q3 reported EPS $3.91 vs consensus est $2.99, revenue $1.36bn vs est $1.33bn, EBITDA $603mm vs est $583mm. FY EBITDA guide raised to $2.10-2.15bn from $2.05-2.13bn.
HUBB Q3 adjusted EPS $5.91 vs consensus est $5.76 on revenue $1.87bn vs est $1.85bn. FY adjusted EPS guide raised to $20.40-20.60 from $20.25-20.55, FY organic sales guided +10-11% vs est +10%.
INIO Q3 sales $1.2bn vs consensus est $1.05bn, EPS $0.15 vs est $0.12, EBITDA $245mm vs est $198mm. FY26 revenue guide raised by $100mm to $3.9-4bn, EBITDA guide $780-800mm.
JCI fiscal Q4 reported EPS $1.66 vs consensus est $1.59 on sales $7.1bn vs est $7.04bn. Q1 EPS guide $1.15-1.20 vs est $1.13, FY27 EPS guide $6.15-6.30 vs est $6.15.
LECO Q3 reported EPS $2.98 vs consensus est $2.81, sales $1.22bn vs est $1.17bn, EBIT $220mm vs est $210mm.
PNR Q3 EPS $1.18 vs consensus est $1.07 on sales $976mm vs est $964mm, including $8mm of IEEPA refunds. Q4 EPS guide $1.15 vs est $1.21, FY EPS $4.70 vs prior range $4.60-4.80.
SHW Q3 reported EPS $3.63 vs consensus est $3.69 on sales $6.86bn vs est $6.78bn. FY EPS guide narrowed to $11.85-12.15 from $11.80-12.20 with the same midpoint.
UPS Q3 EPS $1.69 vs consensus est $1.63 on sales $22.9bn vs est $22.3bn, including a $33mm gain on MD-11 asset sales. FY EPS implied $7.28 vs est $7.19, implied Q4 EPS $2.77.
XYL Q3 EPS $1.44 vs consensus est $1.45, revenue $2.20bn vs est $2.28bn, adjusted EBITDA $527mm vs est $544.3mm. FY EPS guide cut to $5.40-5.45 from $5.55-5.70.
WSO Q3 reported EPS $3.77 vs consensus est $4.10 on revenue $2.22bn vs est $2.21bn, EBIT $225mm vs est $245mm, gross margin 26.4%.
CLW Q3 (reported 10/26 post-market) sales $385mm vs consensus est $392mm, EBITDA $24mm vs est $25mm.
GBX Q4 (reported 10/26 post-market) EPS $0.39 vs consensus est $0.80, revenue $591mm vs est $605mm. 2027 revenue guide $2.8-3.2bn vs est $2.7bn.
JBLU Q3 (reported 10/26 post-market) loss of $0.60 per share vs consensus est loss of $0.55, revenue about $2.8bn in line.
WHR Q3 (reported 10/26 post-market) loss of $0.21 vs consensus est EPS of $0.76, ongoing EBIT below $97mm vs est $176mm, sales $3.68bn vs est $3.91bn.
Implied earnings moves cited by the desk: INIO 16%, JBLU 15%, WHR 10%, HRI 9%, GBX 9%, CLW 7%, ABG 6%, AWI 6%, JCI 6%, UPS 6%, BA 5%, LECO 5%, AIT 4%, SHW 2%.

Muted market volumes at SHW and housing and input cost exposure.
